scenes.label: steps to sort 1 million items: smart vs naive
scenes.narration: Sorting one million items takes a smart algorithm about {c_nl_say} steps. A naive one takes about one trillion.
That is about {c_ratio_say} times more work. The choice of algorithm often matters more than faster hardware.
